title: Payment Structure
intro: All projects follow a 50/50 payment structure:
points: 50% upfront, paid before work begins.
50% upon completion, paid before final delivery and handover.
note: For larger custom projects, milestone-based payment plans may be arranged on request.

title: Package Customization
points: Features from a higher-tier package can be added to a lower-tier package for an additional charge.
Removing features from a package can reduce the standard price accordingly.
Any customization outside the original package scope will be quoted and agreed upon before work begins.

title: Domain & Hosting
points: Domain and hosting costs are separate from the package price.
Costs vary depending on client preference and project requirements, and will be communicated before purchase.

title: Maintenance
points: Monthly maintenance charges vary depending on the scope of the site and client requirements.
Standard maintenance includes uptime monitoring, backups, security updates, minor content edits, and SSL/domain renewal reminders.
Work beyond the agreed maintenance scope (new pages, redesigns, new features) will be quoted separately.
On CMS-based sites, clients may handle basic content updates themselves; ongoing maintenance in that case can be lighter or optional.

title: Revisions
points: Each package includes a set number of revision rounds as agreed at project start.
Additional revisions beyond the included rounds will be billed separately.

title: Project Timeline
points: Estimated delivery timelines will be provided at project start and depend on package scope and client responsiveness in providing content/feedback.
Delays caused by late client feedback or missing content may extend the delivery date accordingly.

title: Content & Assets
points: Clients are expected to provide their own text, images, and branding assets unless otherwise agreed.
Sourcing or writing content on the client's behalf is available as an additional service.

title: Ownership & Handover
points: Final files, source code, and domain/hosting access are handed over to the client upon full payment.
Until final payment is received, ownership and access remain with the developer.

title: Cancellation & Refunds
points: The upfront 50% payment is non-refundable once work has begun, as it covers time and resources already committed.
If a project is cancelled mid-way, work completed up to that point will be delivered in its current state; remaining balance is not owed.

title: Post-Launch Support
points: A short free bug-fix window is included immediately after launch, separate from ongoing monthly maintenance.
Issues reported after this window fall under the maintenance agreement or are billed individually if no maintenance plan is active.
